verdict.rationale: The documented platform MCP server lets an agent in Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex find and add MCP servers without the dashboard, which is a programmatic discovery path. The project also has a catalog of approved tools and third-party servers drawn from the official MCP Registry. However, this interface is framed for org admins. No public REST/OpenAPI catalog API was found: all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI registry endpoint, detail on query and filter semantics for server and tool discovery, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven catalog queries.
